ruleDefinitions.name: Potential SolidPDFCreator.DLL Sideloading
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects potential DLL sideloading of "SolidPDFCreator.dll" Note: Unmapped fields: ImageLoaded

sequences.query: ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\SolidPDFCreator\\\.dll$") AND  NOT ((process_path = RGX("\\\\SolidPDFCreator\\\.exe$") AND (ImageLoaded = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\SolidDocuments\\\\SolidPDFCreator\\\\") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\SolidDocuments\\\\SolidPDFCreator\\\\"))))
